accepted.reason: Markless 0.4.0 modulepreloads every page's whole template as client render data. Measured uncompressed in this check (the mirror and the local server do not compress): 630 kB of it on /directives/model, 295 kB on /start-here. Compressed as served (alpinejs.dev against the deployed front door): / 144.6 -> 117.4 kB, /start-here 145.9 -> 145.2 kB, /directives/model 144.5 -> 160.8 kB. JavaScript that runs at load drops from 76 to 84 kB to 18 kB on every route. Nothing in the port avoids the render data; it is the framework's.
accepted.by: Claude Code (converting agent), for owner review
